class.name: nav2_o11y_risk_layer::O11yRiskLayer
class.description: Paints soft cost into the global costmap based on GNN tracked polygons: risk_k = a_uncertainty * (1 - confidence_k) + b_fragility * max(contributor_ratios_k). Halo decays radially from each polygon centroid; never overwrites LETHAL/INSCRIBED.
